主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada announced on January 29, 2014, that it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Jamaican banking operations, including RBC Royal Bank (Jamaica) Limited and RBTT Securities Jamaica Limited, to Sagicor Group Jamaica Limited. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals, and is expected to be finalized in the coming months. The move aligns with RBC's strategy to focus on regions with significant market share while repositioning its Caribbean business. The deal is expected to result in an estimated loss of C$60 million (before and after-tax) due to International Financial Reporting Standards, primarily from a writedown of goodwill and intangibles acquired in 2008. The loss will be reflected in the first quarter 2014 results, with results and an earnings call scheduled for February 26, 2014.
